extDescription.message: Block ads everywhere, YouTube video ads, banners, pop-ups, trackers, cookie prompts and anti-adblock walls. Free, fast and private.

cosmeticsTitle.message: Cosmetic filtering on this site (turn off if the layout breaks)

logUnavailable.message: Log unavailable right now (browser quota) — try again in a minute.

opt_keep_settings_allowlist_and_filters_.message: Keep settings, allowlist and filters in sync on every Chrome you're signed into

opt_remove_video_ads_on_youtube_turn_off.message: Remove video ads on YouTube. Turn off if videos won't play.

opt_hide_disable_your_adblocker_walls_an.message: Hide "disable your adblocker" walls and restore the page

opt_strip_utm_fbclid_gclid_and_other_cli.message: Strip utm_*, fbclid, gclid and other click identifiers from the links you open

opt_block_known_malware_domains_urlhaus_.message: Block known malware domains (URLhaus list by abuse.ch)

opt_disable_google_topics_floc_and_prote.message: Disable Google Topics, FLoC and Protected Audience ad APIs on every site

opt_stop_third_party_hyperlink_auditing_.message: Stop third-party hyperlink-auditing / beacon pings, strip tracking cookies from known ad-tech responses, and block browser cryptomining scripts. Turn off if a site's analytics-dependent feature misbehaves.

opt_fetches_new_block_rules_and_youtube_.message: Fetches new block rules and YouTube fixes from adblock.carbonstealth.eu. Data only, no code, nothing about you is sent.

opt_live_log_of_ads_caught_heuristically.message: Live log of ads caught heuristically (no filter list), newest first.

opt_subscribed_lists_are_fetched_as_text.message: Subscribed lists are fetched as text (never code), kept up to date daily, and live in the managed blocks above. Remove a list to drop its rules.

opt_elements_you_hid_manually_with_the_p.message: Elements you hid manually with the picker, grouped by site.

opt_live_diagnostics_everything_is_compu.message: Live diagnostics — everything is computed locally. If something is red, "Update now" or reloading the extension usually fixes it.

opt_supreme_adblock_is_free_for_everyone.message: Supreme AdBlock is free for everyone. If you'd like to help keep it maintained, donations are welcome, never required.

opt_subscribe_to_a_filter_list_url_e_g_h.message: Subscribe to a filter list URL (e.g. https://…/list.txt)
